newsitem.title: UK: Toad secures PHH, Ford deals.
newsitem.headline: Toad secures PHH, Ford deals.

text.p: British vehicle security systems firm Toad Plc said on Monday it had won two large supply contracts, one with the country's largest contract hire and leasing company PHH and the other with Ford Motor in the UK.
After the announcement, Toad's share price was marked up to 87.50 pence at 0717 GMT from 80 pence at Friday's close.
Financial details of the deals were not disclosed. However, a company source said that the two contracts had the potential to be worth more than the company's turnover in 1995/96 of 3.0 million stg.
"These are the two largest deals they've had to date, and we're anticipating more," a company spokeswoman told Reuters.
In the deal with PHH, Toad will supply the total security requirement for PHH's 335,000 car and commercial vehicle fleet.

In the other deal Toad will install cellular phones where specfied in new Ford cars sold in the UK. In addition, Toad said in a statement, it was talking to Ford Cellular regarding the development of new cellular services.
Toad, which has been listed on AIM for just over a year, said it saw more room for cooperation with the two companies.
